entities.summary: Dinis Incanha is a Bissau-Guinean brigadier general who led the 2025 coup d'état becoming the Chief of the High Military Command for the Restoration of National Security and Public Order afterwards. Before the coup, he served as the head of the military office of the presidency. He was Guinea-Bissau's de facto leader as Spokesperson of the military junta for a day from 26 to 27 November 2025 after leading the coup d'état, becoming the shortest-serving head of state in Bissau-Guinean history.
